written_before: the first read of the holdout and panel sets by any script in experiments/cache_readouts/
confirmation_set: holdout: the successful_2pt panel models of CIFAR-100 and Tiny ImageNet that carry both headline placements
completeness_set: panel: the 54 successful_2pt models that carry both headline placements, including the dev models, never read as confirmation

pass_statistic.why: On the dev set the pass with the smallest fractional drop separated better than the mean on 8 of 9 models, and the worst pass separated worse on 8 of 9. A triggered input needs only 1 pass that keeps its label, a clean input loses every pass.

predictions.text: best_pass raises PSBD-TM's mean AUROC over mean_psu and the paired 95% interval excludes 0
best_pass raises PSBD-TM's mean TPR at 1% nominal FPR over mean_psu
the worst pass, the statistic N17 proposed, lowers PSBD-TM's mean AUROC below mean_psu

fusion_rule.why: On the 5 dev models where the late band reaches the adaptive target, every fusion rule lifted the WaNet failure. Min-rank and Fisher cost the GTSRB TaCT model most of its TPR at 10% FPR. The 0.9 and 0.1 shares kept most of the WaNet gain and lost the least on TaCT, and the plan's combined design fixes the same shares.

predictions.text: the weighted rule raises mean AUROC over PSBD-TM alone and the paired 95% interval excludes 0
the weighted rule raises mean TPR at 10% nominal FPR over PSBD-TM alone
the weighted rule loses at most 0.01 of mean TPR at 1% nominal FPR
on BadNets and TaCT the weighted rule loses at most 0.01 of mean AUROC per attack

expected_size: The dev gains of the fusion rule are carried by vit_cifar10_wanet_0_1, the PSBD-TM inversion. The holdout holds no PSBD-TM failure of that size, so the fused AUROC gain there should be far smaller than on the dev set, of the size docs/runs/2026-09-29-gpu-queue.md records on the panel.
tie_rule: A pick that ties its reference within its interval is reported as not confirmed, never as a win.
